类 ConsumerSink

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ConsumerSink
所有已实现的接口:
ProgressSink, AutoCloseable
public final class ConsumerSink extends Object implements ProgressSink
Sink that hands rendered frames to your own code.

Use it to integrate with a host application's logging framework, an event bus, a UI text area, or plain System.out.print:

ProgressConfig.builder()
        .sink(ConsumerSink.lines(line -> log.info("{}", line)))
        .build();

Two modes are available: of(Consumer) passes the whole frame (multiple lines are '\\n' separated) to one consumer, lines(Consumer) passes each non-empty line separately.
